S034-01.notes: Spring keeps flowing in driest summers -> inexhaustible. Seasonal contradicts; contaminated/costly unsupported.

S034-02.notes: 3 of 4 wells struck water, project could succeed -> auspicious (favorable sign). Ominous opposite; negligible/ambiguous contradicted by clear positive result.

S034-03.notes: Lumps once thought careless-mixing flaws may enable self-healing. Consistent with 2023 MIT lime-clast study. B/C/D unsupported or off-topic.

S034-04.notes: Expert advantage vanishes on random boards -> advantage from recognizing meaningful patterns (Chase & Simon). A contradicted by random-board result; B, D unsupported.

S034-05.notes: Conclusion needs median A > B and longest B > A; only B compares both. A addresses B's longest vs own median, not vs A's longest; C/D omit median comparison or compare wrong quantities.

S034-06.notes: Replication found smaller, inconsistent differences -> evidence weaker than claimed. A/B overstate; C (sample size) not mentioned.

flags: minor: C is the only choice mentioning the U.S. rejection, which makes it stand out, but that is inherent to the goal
S034-07.notes: Goal: why France. Only C gives reason (rejected by U.S. schools). D explains learning French, not why France.

S034-08.notes: Warm water strengthens storms; stalled storm cools water and weakens itself -> contrast, Conversely. Similarly/For example/Thus wrong relationships.

S034-09.notes: Singular 'performance' of a choir belonging to children: children's choir's. A misplaces apostrophe on irregular plural; B 'choirs performance' lacks possessive; C 'childrens' not a word form.

S034-10.notes: Action ongoing before a past point (completed in 1936) -> past perfect progressive. Dates (1931-1936) accurate.
